note: Hold-out B: 25 hand-written emails added on 2026-10-05 after the first two model runs and before the third. They were never used to change rules or prompts, and model results on them were not looked at before the prompt was frozen.

emails.subject: ERP export still stuck - SR 1-MYH8K2
emails.body:
Hi team,

The ERP export is still stuck (SR 1-MYH8K2) and our finance close starts Thursday morning. If the September invoices are not in SAP by then, we have to post them manually across 40 entities.

Can someone senior look at this today?

Thanks,
Ingrid Solberg
Head of Group Accounting, Northwind Bank

emails.subject: Mahnungen an falschen Kontakt (SR 1-FUATZG)
emails.body:
Guten Morgen,

wir haben heute erneut drei Mahnungen an einen ehemaligen Mitarbeiter erhalten (SR 1-FUATZG). Unser Geschäftsführer ist darüber nicht erfreut, da einer unserer größten Lieferanten betroffen ist.

Bitte korrigieren Sie die Kontaktdaten bis Freitag, sonst müssen wir das intern eskalieren.

Viele Grüße
Jana Krüger

emails.subject: Ceník 1-3YC7UV
emails.body:
Dobrý den,

synchronizace ceníku (1-3YC7UV) stále nefunguje a naši obchodníci od rána posílají zákazníkům špatné ceny. Potřebujeme opravu nejpozději do středy, jinak budeme muset zastavit objednávky.

Děkuji,
Tomáš Dvořák

emails.subject: Túnel VPN caído otra vez - OPS-1103
emails.body:
Hola,

el túnel VPN con nuestro centro de datos se cayó otra vez esta noche (OPS-1103). Es la cuarta vez esta semana y nuestro centro de llamadas estuvo sin sistema durante 40 minutos.

Necesitamos una solución definitiva, no otro reinicio.

Saludos,
Carmen Ruiz
Directora de Operaciones, Wayne Telecom

emails.subject: INT-401 carton data
emails.body:
Hi,

Quick one on INT-401. Our new DC in Leeds opens next Monday and the carton-level data is a hard requirement from the warehouse system - without it every pallet has to be scanned by hand.

Where are we on this?

Mark Ellis
Supply Chain Systems, Globex Retail

emails.subject: RE: RE: RE: duplicate account 1-D88SSQ
emails.body:
This is the fourth email I am sending about the duplicate account (1-D88SSQ). Our agents keep creating policies on the wrong record and we now have 23 customers with split payment histories.

I have copied our COO. I expect a call today.

Brian Okoye
Initech Insurance

emails.subject: Fwd: VAT breakdown on invoices
emails.body:
Can you please see below.

Sam

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@hooli-media.example>
Subject: VAT breakdown on invoices

Sam, our auditors arrive on 15 October and they will reject invoices without a VAT breakdown (the vendor ticket is 1-BXK5YW). Please make sure the vendor fixes this before then.

Laura Chen
Chief Financial Officer

emails.subject: SSO loop is back (OPS-1101)
emails.body:
Good morning,

The SSO login loop (OPS-1101) is back since last night's deployment. Our nurses cannot open patient schedules on the ward tablets and we are falling back to paper.

Our compliance officer needs an incident report by tomorrow 10:00.

Kind regards,
Dr. Amelia Hart
Clinical Systems Lead

emails.subject: Bulk orders failing - 1-9BXLGP
emails.body:
Hello,

Since Friday's release the order API rejects every bulk payload over 500 lines with a 500 error (1-9BXLGP). We have switched to sending orders one by one, which takes about six hours per night instead of 20 minutes.

We can live with this for a few days, but not past the end of the week.

Best,
Felix Wagner

emails.subject: Prélèvement SEPA rejeté - 1-RLR7UU
emails.body:
Bonjour,

Notre banque a de nouveau rejeté le prélèvement SEPA de ce mois (1-RLR7UU). Si le fichier corrigé n'est pas envoyé d'ici jeudi midi, nous perdrons la date de valeur et devrons payer des pénalités à nos transporteurs.

Merci de traiter en priorité.

Cordialement,
Élodie Martin

emails.subject: Wayne - roaming double billing
emails.body:
Heads up: Wayne Telecom's CFO raised the double-billed roaming (1-GLGQ5F) on our QBR call this morning and said they will withhold payment on all open invoices until it is fixed.

Can we get this off 'waiting on customer'? They sent the logs on Friday.

Anna
Account Manager

emails.subject: RE: 1-ML7N8X quarterly invoice
emails.body:
Hi,

Thanks for the corrected invoice for 1-ML7N8X, it came through in EUR this time. No need to rush the root cause on our side, the next quarterly run is in January.

Best,
Paul

emails.subject: Gutschrift 1-K83FYQ
emails.body:
Hallo zusammen,

die Gutschrift (1-K83FYQ) ist inzwischen auf unserem Konto sichtbar. Für uns ist das Thema damit erledigt, Sie können das Ticket schließen.

Danke und Grüße
Lukas Becker

emails.subject: RE: [OPS-1102] consumer lag
emails.body:
Morning,

The lag on the orders topic has stayed under a minute since you added the extra consumers yesterday. We'll keep watching it, but from our side this can go back to normal priority.

Thanks,
Raj

emails.subject: Price list 1-KF53XX - new start date
emails.body:
Hi,

Small update on 1-KF53XX: our new contract now starts on 1 November instead of 1 December, so the new price list needs to be live by 30 October. Not urgent today, just so you can plan.

Regards,
Nora Quinn
